messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for prefill-cache v6.0.0 -> canary (us-west-1). Running post-deploy smoke: prefill-warmup, kv-prefill, and heartbeat. Report anomalies here.

rafael: FYI seeing a sharp spike in concurrent kv-prefill latencies on the first canary wave in us-west-1. p95 jumped 100ms -> 1400ms and p99s look catastrophic. Error rate still low but stalls present.

ivy: any OOMs or 5xx?

linda: no OOMs. Traces show many probes waiting on backend cache fetches for ~1.2s each. Looks like a thundering herd when the new pods warmed up and TTLs expired.

eng-sre: did the canary include a change to cache keying or TTL?

rafael: v6.0.0 tuned prefill TTL from 30s -> 1s for more freshness. That plus small canary concurrency bump likely produced simultaneous upstream cache misses.

ivy: that explains the stall. Two mitigation options: 1) revert TTL change quickly via config rollback, or 2) pin region routing back to last-known-good v5.9.7 for us-west-1 and continue rollout elsewhere. Pin has less blast radius.

release-manager: prefer regional pin so other regions can continue. If we pin, add a release note and open a follow-up ticket to revisit TTL defaults and warmup preflight.

linda: applying regional routing override to v5.9.7 now.

deploy-bot: Action logged: routing.pin applied -> region=us-west-1, target_version=5.9.7, actor=linda (3355551241). Canary wave for us-west-1 paused.

ivy: reran smoke suite after pin. prefill-warmup p95 back to 110ms, p99s cleared, 0/50 probes with >500ms.

eng-sre: good containment. Opening ENG-9999 to track root cause: evaluate TTL change, add staggered warmup and randomized backoff to prefill probes, and ensure rollout controller validates cache TTL flips in preflight. Assigning to @rafael and @linda.

rafael: quick short-term idea before next attempt: add a randomized startup jitter to prefill probe schedule and a check that prevents enabling a sub-1s TTL across more than 5% of fleet during canary. I'll sketch a patch.

release-manager: adding brief entry to release notes: us-west-1 pinned to v5.9.7 due to prefill-cache thundering when TTL reduced in v6.0.0; rollout continues in other regions pending ENG-9999.

linda: scheduled reattempt window tentatively for 2026-03-28 17:00 UTC after mitigation PR and a synthetic canary run. Will keep thread updated.

ivy: also recommend adding a preflight smoke that runs a small fanout of prefill requests directly after image rollout but before traffic flip, to catch this pattern proactively.

eng-sre: agreed. Please include that preflight in the rollout-controller hotfix. Closing the immediate alert — regional pin successful and health restored. Leaving thread open for ENG-9999 updates. :white_check_mark:
